all_obligations.exact_statement:
Establish the following finite relative-integer-code reliability theorem and complete specified-pair resource comparison, under Definitions D1-D8. The stochastic source, exact finite encoders, error location, controls, output format and accounting model are part of this contract, not interchangeable examples. Sources and reviews copied from preceding projects are provenance, not automatically admitted premises here.

C1. One common unknown-(u,t) causal JOINT program in D4, with the original public A/p schedule, obeys for every N>=3, dyadic Q=2^b>=2, integer d>=6, all D1 u,t, and every D3 admissible source-independent map on its actual cut:
R_av <=12000000/N+256 eta^2+3/Q,
R_00 <=1800000/(1+N*u)+256 eta^2+3/Q^2.
The two bounds belong to the same program. Prove its real finite count perturbation, smoothing/clipping, probability and KL transfer, exact positive grid branches and all-input guards, and establish/legally discharge all clean statistical and finite-program premises through this project's normal evidence chain. Unknown u,t are not provided. N=3,4,5 bypass the cut and output uniform; Q2, Q4, zero counts and ties are included.

C2. Fix any integer d>=6, eta=2^-d, u=eta/65536, N=2^L with M=N/2-2 and M*u^2>=2^40, and the original A/p schedule. There exists one deterministic public globally admissible Phi_*, independent of t and of the decoder, such that for every common source-independent possibly randomized post-cut decoder of the FULL19 code in D2-D3, one t_* in {1/4,3/4} has R_00>=3/64 and R_av>=3u/64 under that same Phi_* and source. This includes unrestricted probability outputs, hence every positive dyadic output format. Prove using the full actual finite observation law, retaining all nineteen words, five small slots, initial-pair information, protected E_m/S_N and their genuine terminal dependence; population aliases or failure of one decoder are insufficient. No claim is made for arbitrary re-encoders, every source, all N,u, or fixed-source inconsistency.

C3. For N>=6 use Bstar(N,b,d). For N=3,4,5, no cut/frontend is instantiated; the uniform-output branch, including charged input handling and guarded output writes, is charged within Bstar(6,b,d). Realize the specific MIX and JOINT programs of D4 on the same one-shot batch input and positive guarded output port, with all local binding/features, finite evaluation, code/masks/metadata, word/address widths, copies/clears/holds, online work/storage/peak and offline generation charged. Prove both fit the explicit common public Bstar(N,b,d) vector in D6, in the principal extracted-query hybrid dense tokenwise model; do not replace it with streaming widths, the all-token/all-phase padded layout, a fully neural flattened model, or unit-cost arithmetic. Show all cut ancestors are actually erased and post-cut decoders remain defined for closed input boxes.
For every d>=32 use N=2^(2d+74), Q=2^(2d), u=2^(-d-16). Under the SAME Phi_* and SAME t_* selected in C2 for the concrete MIX decoder, JOINT has R_av<u/64 and R_00<1/64, while MIX has R_av>=3u/64 and R_00>=3/64. Thus the average and conditional gaps exceed u/32 and1/32 respectively, within the one common complete available vector. A common upper envelope is not equal expenditure, componentwise efficiency, or a resource lower bound over optimized architectures. Carry the D7 erratum: along this unchanged schedule the displayed conditional upper expression is Theta(eta), not O(eta^2); the noise contribution alone is O(eta^2).

C4. Preserve and verify the paid strong alternatives in D7: uniform joint finite gain can encode j=C; integers below2^min(d,h) are locked and permit count packing under8 ceil(log2(M+1))<=19min(d,h), including d>=195 on C3's schedule; precomputed b-bit output packing is possible when b<=19min(d,h), including b=2d on that schedule. Charge their acquisition, conversion, packing, copy/erasure and output; distinguish encoder changes from decoders of the frozen FULL19 cut. Retain these counterconstructions against broader same-capacity claims, not as violations of C2. Complete fixed-version independent review, exact bounded primary/claim mapping, new-project native admissions, root proof and separate final_audit. [Non-scientific operational metadata omitted.] A prior discussion PASS, file copy, component admission or this root SOLVED is not v10 completion. No publication novelty, learned/IEEE/all-layer robustness, practical constants or optimized neural advantage is claimed.
